title: Excellent machine and coffee!
text: I saw a Clio add on Facebook.  It sounded pretty good...70% off a coffee maker and 60 pods for first order.  The machine in excellent, solid metal.  The coffee is incredible.  I have my Keurig K-Elite next to my Clio and use Clio far more.  Definitely recommend the machine and coffee.  Only downside is that pods can only be found on Clio site and Amazon but even that is OK for the quality.
label: positive
